title: Two-Line Rapid Fire
setup: Split team into two parallel lines (SS and 2B). Both coaches stand near home plate.
execution: Coach 1 hits a grounder to SS. The second it hits the glove, Coach 2 hits to 2B. Fielder throws to target net and hustles to the back of the opposite line.
cultureCue: Hustle standard. Praise the kids who sprint to the back of the opposite line, not just the ones who make a good throw. Effort is the baseline.

title: Heavy Ball Front Toss
setup: L-screen 15 feet from home plate. Batter in box, one on deck, rest behind fence.
execution: Feeder tosses weighted balls to front hip. Rotate every 10 swings.
focus: Staying through the baseball without rolling over.
cultureCue: Active listening. The player on deck must watch the batter and listen to the coach's feedback so they don't make the same mistake.

title: Twenty-One Point Shootout
setup: Kids take standard infield positions. Coach at home plate with a bat.
execution: Coach hits random grounders. Scoring: Clean field + good throw to first = 1 point. Bobble but gets the out = 0 points. Ball gets past them or wild throw = -1 point. First player to 5 points wins.
focus: Live game pressure, making routine plays securely.
cultureCue: Handling failure. Watch how they react to losing points. Praise players who reset quickly for the next pitch instead of hanging their heads.
